notes.title: Tuoni Devlog #1 - Class & Skill Systems
notes.content:
[p]It's time for a new Tuoni update, and it's about classes and buildcrafting in Tuoni. [/p][p][/p][p]At the start of the last devlog, I celebrated reaching almost 1.5k Wishlists. Well, two weeks later, and we are at a whopping 2.5k wishlists already! Thank you for all the support![/p][p][/p][p]This is an extra-interesting devlog for me, as Tuoni started as a hobby project where I explored how to make interesting buildcrafting experiences. My goal was to provide an experience where character-building is how I find it best: wild, free, and at best, chaotic, without too much handholding or mapped-out paths. I love it when players find synergies and even broken combinations all by themselves (as long as they are not [b]too easy[/b] to find). I hope to capture some of that theorycrafting and freedom of builds in Tuoni![/p][p][/p][p][b]All of this means that I want each class to be:[/b][/p][list][*][p] Unique in how they interact with game systems (classes are not just flavors of warriors, but different types of warriors with different stat/mechanic utilization)[/p][/*][*][p]Offer different ways for players to deal with tough situations[/p][/*][*][p]Offer some synergy that other class/classes can latch on to.[/p][/*][*][p]Act as a guidance post, not as a restrictive pasture (Mixing classes is a core design pillar, not the "nice and extra exception")[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Each class will be intended to be [b]mixed & matched[/b] with other classes. I hope that players will discover weird synergies and powerful combinations, while still finding decent paths inside a single class to get up to speed. I have always adored games that do not give you a class fantasy directly: It is more satisfying to create Mage Assassin by your own choices and creativity, than simply click through a ready-made tree. Naturally, this is just my vision, so go ahead and drop your opinions below![/p][p][/p][h3]For starters, a quick & very basic introduction to Stat-system:[/h3][p][b]Constitution:[/b] Health points and natural physical armor.[/p][p][b]Might: [/b]How well the character utilizes physical damage (weapons, melee damage, physical skills).[/p][p][b]Mysticism: [/b]How well the character utilizes magical damage (spells, elemental damage)[/p][p][b]Wisdom:[/b] Natural magical armor, slight boost to magical damage & some off-combat benefits.[/p][p][/p][p]Alongside stats, the game features a bunch of weapon skills that develop as you use said weapon:

[b]Blades:[/b] Can inflict bleed-stacks on hits.[/p][p][b]Axes:[/b] Can pierce armor on hit, effectively ignoring it.[/p][p][b]Hammers:[/b] Have a chance to cripple the enemy, reducing their effective damage to half. [/p][p][b]Staves:[/b] When hitting an enemy, occasionally deal additional melee hit with 50% damage, proccing all on-hit effects.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Stat's window.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663550/151434617dbec1c4581f10937f99a3105f5d04db.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]That being said, let's dive into the classes!
[/p][h2]Classes Planned for the Demo[/h2][p][/p][p]For Demo, I tried to include a good slice of classes so that a couple of different playstyles and some interesting synergies can be found! Each class scales from different stat/stats, and offers unique tools for surviving in the wilds! You can also see a couple of different elemental damage types here and there - those are useful against different types of enemies![/p][p][b]Note:[/b] As development is still heavily ongoing, everything is subject to change.[/p][p][/p][h3]Warrior[/h3][p]The standard, good-old warrior. Scales from [b]Might[/b] and is focused on hitting creatures with various weapons. [/p][p][/p][h3]Vanguard[/h3][p]Big and bulky. Unlike normal Warriors, they utilize [b]Constitution[/b] to deliver damage while withstanding heavy blows with defensive skills.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Ravager[/h3][p]Focuses on dealing bleed-stacks to enemies. Said stacks can then be consumed to deal heavy single-target damage. Utilizes mainly [b]Might.[/b][/p][p][i] Rat demonstrates bleeding damage, which is even handier with bigger enemies - it does always 5% of max HP as damage![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663550/81558f964978d0824982f8c2642e82431665218e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Arms Master[/h3][p]Utilizes and enhances weapon-specific skills. Very usable side-class for many melee classes![/p][p][/p][h3]Warlock[/h3][p]Another bleed-stack enjoyer, but this time in Shadow-damage & caster-form. Spells scale from [b]Mysticism[/b].[/p][p][i]Kalma's Bolt obliterates Rock Gnome with potent Shadow Damage.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663550/c70572c8b63ae7f15d6e8598d324353249a57b82.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Lakeborn[/h3][p]Finland is a country of "thousands of lakes", so naturally, mages use that as their advantage.
Spells that deal [b]Fen-damage[/b] (fancy name for water) and offer sustenance in the form of healing/buffing. Utilizes [b]Mysticism & Wisdom.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Frostborn[/h3][p]Northern wilds have very potent frost-magic that deals frost damage and offer elements of control, such as ice-wall or AOE-stuns in the form of ice-quekes. Utilizes [b]Mysticism & Wisdom.[/b][/p][p][i]Frostborn masters AOE-stuns. Also note "Shatterable armor", which both enemies have - it blocks damage completely on first hit, but is still vulnerable to stuns.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663550/ea43548bab08de793fd42452d0c7630b0d077679.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Mindpiercer[/h3][p]Who said fighters need to be dumb? Mind meets the blade! [b]Wisdom-scaling[/b] melee skills, which also benefit from [b]Meditation[/b] utility (see below). [/p][p][/p][h3]Shaman[/h3][p]Forest-dweller who utilizes [b]Mysticism [/b]and deals a heavy amount of Verdant damage with their spells and enchants. Offers also meditation skills, where the player enters a [b]Meditative state,[/b] gaining buffs while sacrificing some of their defences.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]So, for the upcoming Demo, this is the planned palette of classes. The full version of the game will feature a wider array of classes (and even one more elemental damage category), but more on those later.  

I gladly hear all feedback, ideas, and first thoughts from the community! 

Thanks for reading, and remember to wishlist if you have not yet! See you in the next Devlog!

- Old Dog[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Tuoni Devlog #0 - Towards the Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Tuoni - Towards the Demo[/h1][p][/p][p]Greetings all! Throwing a small update here about the current state of development and how the demo is coming together.[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, I am thrilled to say that the [b]game has received almost 1,000 wishlists[/b] in its first month of visibility on Steam, and that's huge! Thank you to all who wishlisted and showed your support![/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][h2]First Demo[/h2][p]
I aim to release the first demo during Q4 of this year, to gather as much feedback as possible, and have sufficient time to incorporate changes before release in Q2/Q3 of 2026. So all ideas and feedback from the community will be super valuable.[/p][p][/p][p]Demo will include:[/p][list][*][p]Handful of classes & skills to test out (specified & introduced more in later devlogs!)[/p][/*][*][p]Procedurally generated world (including procedural villages).[/p][/*][*][p]A couple of hand-crafted locations, including the start of the main story.[/p][/*][*][p]V1 of procedural dialogue/lore found in wilderness/villages.[/p][/*][*][p]Five biomes with unique enemies, beasts & fauna. (Will be posting about this soon as well!)[/p][/*][*][p]Bosses/Elite enemies, both handcrafted & procedurally generated.[/p][/*][*][p]The usual things: Combat, character development, dialogue & trading systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Recent addition: Gathering & equipment enhancing system.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]First version of the [b]Equipment Enhancing[/b] system (currently in development)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663550/e133267334acb0177a64190b2b85698287285b21.png"][/img][/p][p]All of the systems above already exist and function fine. Most work goes into adding content (story, enemies, lore, handcrafted locations) and fine-tuning/juicing the systems, which is the main focus for the upcoming months.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Road Ahead[/h2][p][/p][p]After the demo is done (and with it, all the base systems in place, which is currently 90% done), the plan is: [/p][list][*][p]Fine-tune existing systems & incorporate feedback & ideas.[/p][/*][*][p]Add tons of new content [/p][/*][*][p]Balance, balance, and balance (which will probably be slightly off in the first demo)[/p][/*][*][p]Keep updating the demo when major updates happen.[/p][/*][*][p]Prepare for a playtest of the complete product[/p][/*][/list][p]I will also keep posting these devlogs during the development, the next most likely being about classes planned for the demo, and my vision behind the character development & buildcrafting in Tuoni! So remember to follow the Steam page to stay updated about the development, and even participate by giving extremely valuable feedback! [/p][p][/p][p][b]For more updates, remember to follow my [url="https://bsky.app/profile/old-doggo.bsky.social"]Bluesky account[/url] as well! And don't forget to wishlist if you haven't yet![/b]
 
Cheers!

- Old Dog[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
